name: High Inquisitor Merey
desc:
High Inquisitor Merey is a Canor NPC. She is the lead of the Inquisitor division for [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) garrison positioned in the Eastern Luminant, the second to possess this rank, and a Thundercaller.

She appears aged with small wrinkles around her eyes. She wears an Inquisitor's Visor, a Brilliant Cape, an Inquisitor's Duster, and a pair of Grand Authority Sabatons. On her right side, she holsters a bell at her hip, signifying her strength to obtain a Resonance. On her left side she wields the Big Brother dagger.
additional_info:
-   Due to her rank, Merey does not have floral-themed codenames other Inquisitors have.
-   As a Handler, reading the Operation 'Puppet Master' Report will unlock new dialogue.
